title: AARO under Kirkpatrick as a fly trap for UFO information
summary: Jesse Michels tells of AARO under Kirkpatrick as a fly trap for UFO information, about 2022-2023 at AARO, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And it is now kind of patently obvious that the first iteration of this under Sean Kirkpatre was literally a fly trap for you know UFO information probably had legacy ties.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels argues that the first version of AARO, a Pentagon office set up in 2022 to look into reports of unidentified objects in the sky, was run by a director named Sean Kirkpatrick as a "fly trap" for UFO information. In his telling, the office drew in reports and witnesses so the information could be caught and held rather than shared, and it probably had ties to older secret programs. If true, it would mean the office meant to bring things into the open was doing the opposite.
